		OR = {

				}
			}
			AND = { # modification of the standard trigger, only other anarchic countries can impose anarchy on their subjects

		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {

REPLACE:law_autocracy = {
	group = lawgroup_distribution_of_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/autocracy.dds"
	progressiveness = -100
	on_activate = {
bpm_disable_elective_laws = yes
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_voting_franchise = no }
			cleanup_voting_strength_modifiers = yes
			bpm_remove_voting_strength_modifiers = yes
			if = {
				limit = { bpm_country_is_republic = yes }
				scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
			}
			else = {
				scripted_effect_parties_disappearence = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_law = {
				limit = {
					type = law_type:law_autocracy
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_voting_law
			}
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		game_date > 1836.1.1
			# 	}
			# 	initialize_electoral_confidence = yes
			# }
			handle_possible_absent_caciquismo_variables = yes
			inherit_caciquismo_effect = yes
			inherit_free_elections_effect = yes
			scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				bpm_country_is_republic = yes	
				NOT = { has_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size }
			}
			add_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_legitimacy_govt_total_clout_add = 100
	country_legitimacy_govt_size_add = 2
	country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.25

	state_pop_pol_str_mult = -0.5
	state_pop_pol_str_add = -2
	country_electoral_confidence_impact_mult = -1
	country_authority_add = 200
	country_colonial_stability_drift_add = 0.2
	country_colonial_invest_effectiveness_add = -0.2
	country_cultural_pull_mult = -0.05
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = 3
	country_sol_expectations_upper_offset_add = 2.5
	country_judicial_independence_ceiling_mult = -0.5
	country_court_challenges_ignored_bool = yes
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_distribution_of_power_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}

#Petitions

			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
				OR = {
					AND = {
						power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_ideological_union }
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda					
					}
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
				}
				scope:target_country = { 
					NOR = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?

		}
		if = {
			limit = {

			}

				var:bpm_headofgov ?= {

				}

					limit = {has_role = bpm_character_role_protege}
					remove_character_role = bpm_character_role_protege
				}

			bpm_end_regency = yes
		}

			limit = {
				country_has_monarchy_law = yes
				country_has_non_monarchy_law = no # To handle an execution order issue

				country_assess_daimyo_alignments = yes

        		    }

        		}

				}

				every_scope_character = {
					limit = {has_role = bpm_character_role_protege}
					remove_character_role = bpm_character_role_protege
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {NOT = {has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_answers_to_legislature}}
				bpm_end_acting_hog = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				ruler = {
					is_adult = no
					NOT = { has_variable = regency_complete }
				}
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = regency.1
				popup = yes
			}
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_legitimacy_govt_size_add = 1
	country_aristocrats_pol_str_mult = 0.25
	country_officers_pol_str_mult = 0.5
	country_soldiers_pol_str_mult = 0.25

	country_bpm_hog_veto = yes

REPLACE:law_corporate_state = {
	group = lawgroup_governance_principles
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/corporate_state.dds"
	progressiveness = 50
	unlocking_technologies = {
corporatism
	}
	is_visible = {
always = no
	}
	on_activate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_constitutionalist
				}
			}
			every_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_constitutionalist
				}
				remove_ideology = ideology_constitutionalist
				add_ideology = ideology_republican
			}
		}	
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 1
			}
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_corporate_state_trade_unions_bias }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 2
			}
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_corporate_state_industrialists_bias }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 3
			}
			add_modifier = { name = modifier_corporate_state_intelligentsia_bias }
		}
	}
	on_enact = {
if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 1
			}
			custom_tooltip = corporate_state_trade_unions_bias_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 2
			}
			custom_tooltip = corporate_state_industrialists_bias_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:corporatist_nominating_body_var ?= 3
			}
			custom_tooltip = corporate_state_intelligentsia_bias_tt
		}
	}
	on_deactivate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_trade_unions_bias
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_trade_unions_bias
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_industrialists_bias
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_industrialists_bias
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_intelligentsia_bias
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_corporate_state_intelligentsia_bias
		}
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_governance_principles_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.1
	country_authority_add = 100
	interest_group_ig_petty_bourgeoisie_pol_str_mult = 0.25
	country_cultural_pull_mult = -0.02
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = 1
	}
	ai_will_do = {
exists = ruler
		ruler = {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
			}
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_nationalist_agenda				
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
			multiply = 5.0
		}
			
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target_country = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					OR = {	
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_military
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_council_republic = {
	group = lawgroup_governance_principles
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/council_republic.dds"
	progressiveness = 200
	unlocking_technologies = {
socialism
	}
	can_enact = {
custom_tooltip = {
			text = has_factory_councils_law_or_amendment_tt
			has_factory_councils_law_or_amendment = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = had_proletarian_revolution_tt
			has_global_variable_map = first_proletarian_revolution
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_party_anti_socialist
			}
			deactivate_law = law_type:law_party_anti_socialist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
                    bpm_has_movement_interaction = { int = agrarian_socialist_takeover }
                }
			}
			bpm_do_agrarian_socialist_takeover = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_template_used = rus_lenin_character_template
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = s:STATE_INGRIA
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = s:STATE_INGRIA
				}
				set_hub_name = {
					type = city
					name = HUB_NAME_STATE_INGRIA_city_russian_sov # St. Petersburg only becomes Leningrad if Lenin has been around to be a namesake
				}
			}
		}
		transition_off_of_monarchy_effects = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= this
				ruler ?= {
					has_template = POR_manuel_ii_de_braganca_template
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = portuguese_monarchs.3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				active_law:lawgroup_labour_associations ?= {
					has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_factory_councils
				}
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = enact_law_radical_leftist_government_warning_desc
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_overlapping_interests = ROOT
				}
				create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
					type = catalyst_socialist_government
					target = root
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_journal_entry = je_communism_1
					has_journal_entry = je_communism_2
					has_journal_entry = je_state_and_revolution
					has_variable = rcw_russian_faction
				}
			}
			trigger_event = { id = communism.2 popup = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_global_variable = socialist_world_republic
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = enact_law_interest_rates_and_trade_advantage_warning_desc
			}
		}
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_governance_principles_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_legitimacy_govt_total_votes_add = 10
	country_bureaucrats_voting_power_add = 10
	country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.25
	state_pop_pol_str_add = 0.2
	country_institution_economy_max_investment_add = 2
	country_cultural_pull_mult = 0.02
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = -1
	}
	ai_will_do = {
exists = ruler
		OR = {
			ruler = {
				OR = {
					bpm_leader_is_radical_socialist = yes
					interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes }
				}
			}
			any_interest_group = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						exists = ruler
						ruler = {
							OR = {
								bpm_leader_is_radical_socialist = yes
								interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes }
							}
						}
					}
					any_interest_group = {
						bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes
						is_powerful = yes
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda				
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
			multiply = 5.0
		}
	}

}

			add = 750

				OR = {

						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship

					}
				}

		}

				}

					has_journal_entry = je_portugal_regeneration_agriculture

				}
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}

			}
		}
	}
	can_impose = {

		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_distribution_of_power_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {

			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
				OR = {
					AND = {
						power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_ideological_union }
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda					
					}
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
				}
				scope:target_country = { 
					NOR = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
						has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
					}
				}
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_legacy_slavery = {
	group = lawgroup_slavery
	progressiveness = 50
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/legacy_slavery.dds"
	unlocking_laws = {
law_slave_trade
	}
	can_enact = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = c:USA
			}
			NOT = { has_modifier = bpm_gag_rule }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = c:BRZ
				root = { 
					has_dlc_feature = rp1_content
					is_player = yes
				}
			}
			NOT = { has_modifier = unrestricted_slave_trade_modifier }
		}
	}
	disallowing_laws = {
law_council_republic
	}
	on_activate = {
if = {
			limit = { has_variable = slavery_recently_abolished }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = enslave_discriminated_farm_workers_tt
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = { has_variable = former_slave_state }
					enslave_discriminated_farm_workers = yes
				}			
			}
			remove_variable = slavery_recently_abolished
			every_scope_state = {
				remove_variable = former_slave_state
			}
		}
		#bpm_make_igs_pro_slavery = yes
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = bpm_landowner_wary } }
				add_modifier = { name = bpm_landowner_wary }
			}
		}
		ig:ig_reactionaries ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					NOT = { has_modifier = bpm_landowner_wary } 
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_slave_economy
				}
				add_modifier = { name = bpm_landowner_wary }
			}
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_aristocrats_pol_str_mult = 0.4
	country_wealth_concentration_slavery_add = 10
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
value = 0
		#Brazilian AI is more likely to pursue legacy slavery if there are abolitionists in power.
		if = {
			limit = { 
				c:BRZ ?= this
				has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
				OR = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						}
					}
					ruler = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist }
					heir = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist }
				}
				scope:law.type = law_type:law_legacy_slavery #PBF
			}
			add = 500
		}
		# Brazilian AI is more likely to pursue legacy slavery if the Aberdeen Act is being enforced
		if = {
			limit = { 
				c:BRZ ?= this
				has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
				has_modifier = aberdeen_act_enforced_brz
				scope:law.type = law_type:law_legacy_slavery #PBF
			}
			add = 500
		}
		#Petitions
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
		# Strong tendency towards abolitionism in the late game
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BRZ ?= this
				has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
				has_technology_researched = human_rights
				NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda }
					any_political_movement = { 
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_slave_trade
							value < disapprove
						}
					}		
				}	
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_local_police = {
	group = lawgroup_policing
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/local_police.dds"
	unlocking_technologies = {

	}

	country_rigidity_rate_add = 0.05
	}

			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_policing_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law

			}

NOR = {

			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0

			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police

			add = 500
		}

			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}

				has_journal_entry = je_hawaii
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0

			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_local_police
				power_bloc ?= { has_principle_group = principle_group:principle_group_police_coordination }
			}

					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police
				}
				power_bloc ?= { has_principle_group = principle_group:principle_group_police_coordination }
			}
			add = 10
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target_country = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_military
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_populist_movement_support_add = 0.05
	}

REPLACE:law_monarchy = {
	group = lawgroup_governance_principles
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/monarchy.dds"
	progressiveness = 0
	disallowing_laws = {
law_anarchy
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_governance_principles_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_aristocrats_pol_str_mult = 0.25
	country_rigidity_baseline_add = 10
	country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.33
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = 1
	}
	ai_will_do = {
exists = ruler
		ruler = {
			has_monarchist_ideology = yes
		}
		NOT = { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_new_world }
	}
	on_activate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_party_anti_reactionary
			}
			deactivate_law = law_type:law_party_anti_reactionary
			bpm_deactivate_syndicalism = yes
		}
		# Generates French monarch upon enaction.
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRA ?= this
				NOT = {
					has_variable = one_true_french_dynasty
				}
				has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
				game_date > 1836.1.1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
				}
				remove_variable = fra_divided_monarchists_freeze
			}
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_divided_monarchists }
		}
		# Generates French monarch upon enaction.
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					c:FRA ?= this
					NOT = {
						has_variable = one_true_french_dynasty
					}
					has_dlc_feature = voice_of_the_people_content
					game_date > 1836.1.1
					NOR = {
						ruler_is_bonapartist = yes
						ruler_is_orleanist = yes
						ruler_is_legitimist = yes
					}
				}
				fra_handle_republic_monarch_assignment = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
       	 		has_dlc_feature = ip4_content
				c:SPA ?= this
				is_revolutionary = no
				is_secessionist = no
				game_date > 1836.1.1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = activate_provisional_government_tt
				bpm_start_regency = yes
				add_journal_entry = { type = je_spain_provisional_government }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:vietnamese
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_CAMBODIA
					}
				}
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						state_region = s:STATE_CAMBODIA
					}
					STATE_CAMBODIA_state_name_assign = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_LAOS
					}
				}
				random_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						state_region = s:STATE_LAOS
					}
					STATE_LAOS_state_name_assign = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_deactivate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					has_law = law_type:law_subjecthood
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = because_subjecthood_is_active_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						save_temporary_scope_as = ig_to_check
						owner = {
							any_law = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number > 0
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ordered_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						is_in_government = yes
						save_temporary_scope_as = ig_to_check
						owner = {
							any_law = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number > 0
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
						}
					}
					order_by = ig_clout
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = ig_to_check
					owner = {
						ordered_law = {
							limit = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
							position = 0
							order_by = bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number
							check_range_bounds = no
							prev.owner = {
								activate_law = prev.type
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				activate_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
			}
		}
		remove_regency_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {has_law = law_type:law_bakufu}
			deactivate_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			activate_law = law_type:law_answers_to_legislature
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
				power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_ideological_union }
				scope:target_country = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_theocracy }
				}				
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight	
			if = {
				limit = { 
					scope:target_country = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic } 
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda }
				}
				multiply = 5
			}	
			else = {
				multiply = 0.5 # AI is less likely to mess with governance principles unless dealing with council republics
			}
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_oligarchy = {
	group = lawgroup_distribution_of_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/oligarchy.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	on_activate = {
bpm_disable_elective_laws = yes
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_voting_franchise = no }
			cleanup_voting_strength_modifiers = yes
			bpm_remove_voting_strength_modifiers = yes
			if = {
				limit = { bpm_country_is_republic = yes }
				scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
			}
			else = {
				scripted_effect_parties_disappearence = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_law = {
				limit = {
					type = law_type:law_autocracy
				}
				save_scope_as = relevant_voting_law
			}
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		game_date > 1836.1.1
			# 	}
			# 	initialize_electoral_confidence = yes
			# }
			handle_possible_absent_caciquismo_variables = yes
			inherit_caciquismo_effect = yes
			inherit_free_elections_effect = yes
			scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				bpm_country_is_republic = yes	
				NOT = { has_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size }
			}
			add_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_legitimacy_govt_total_clout_add = 115
	country_legitimacy_govt_size_add = 2
	country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.25
	country_aristocrats_pol_str_mult = 0.40
	country_bureaucrats_pol_str_mult = 0.40
	country_capitalists_pol_str_mult = 0.40
	country_officers_pol_str_mult = 0.40
	country_authority_add = 100
	state_pop_pol_str_add = -2
	country_electoral_confidence_impact_mult = -1
	country_colonial_stability_drift_add = 0.1
	country_colonial_invest_effectiveness_add = -0.2
	country_cultural_pull_mult = -0.03
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = 1
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_distribution_of_power_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
				OR = {
					AND = {
						power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_ideological_union }
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda					
					}
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
				}
				scope:target_country = { 
					NOR = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
						has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
					}
				}
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_peasant_proprietorship = {
	group = lawgroup_land_reform
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/freeholders.dds"
	progressiveness = 50
	is_visible = {
NOT = {
			has_law = law_type:law_homesteading
		}
		NOT = {
			country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
		}
		capital ?= {
			is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_old_world
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_farmers_pol_str_mult = 0.15
	building_group_bg_subsistence_agriculture_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.25
	building_group_bg_subsistence_ranching_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.25
	building_group_bg_agriculture_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.25
	building_group_bg_ranching_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.25
	country_financial_districts_buy_farms_likelihood = 0.25
	state_minimum_incorporated_subsistence_arable_land_add = 0.35
	state_wealth_concentration_land_add = -10
	country_populist_movement_support_add = 0.05
	}
	on_enact = {
if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = farmers_pb_ig_shift_effect_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = rural_laborers_tu_ig_shift_effect_negative_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_pedro_brazil
				NOT = { has_variable = landreform_pedropoint }
			}
			set_variable = landreform_pedropoint
			remove_pedropoint_effect = yes
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0

		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_meiji_main
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
			}
			add = 10000 # Top priority for Meiji AI is to get out of Serfdom
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = is_carlist_spain
				}
				OR = {
					has_journal_entry = je_portugal_regeneration_agriculture
					has_journal_entry = je_spa_economic_regeneration_land_reform
				}
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}

		# AI should really try to get out of Serfdom under the right circumstances
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda }
					any_political_movement = {
						law_enactment_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
							value > neutral
						}
						political_movement_support >= 0.10
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}
	institution = institution_economy
	institution_modifier = {
building_group_bg_agriculture_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.05
		building_group_bg_ranching_allowed_collectivization_add = 0.05
		state_farmers_investment_pool_efficiency_mult = 0.05
		state_shopkeepers_investment_pool_efficiency_mult = 0.05
	}

}

				power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_ideological_union }
				scope:target_country = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic }
				}				
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
			if = {
				limit = { 
					scope:target_country = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic } 
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda }
				}
				multiply = 5
			}	
			else = {
				multiply = 0.5 # AI is less likely to mess with governance principles unless dealing with council republics
			}
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_state_religion = {
	group = lawgroup_church_and_state
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/state_religion.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	is_visible = {
# Turkey should only unlock this as a possibility if it abolishes the Millet System, likewise other Muslim nations
		NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_millet_system
			has_law = law_type:law_people_of_the_book
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:atheist
			}
			set_state_religion = root.country_definition.religion
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = antireligious_policies
			}
			remove_modifier = antireligious_policies
		}
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
	}
	modifier = {
country_clergymen_pol_str_mult = 0.5
	country_authority_add = 200
	country_state_religion_wages_mult = 0.1
	country_non_state_religion_wages_mult = -0.1
	country_acceptance_state_religion_add = 25
	country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_add = 0
	country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_group_add = -10
	country_acceptance_no_shared_religious_trait_add = -25
	country_allow_conversion_violent_hostility_bool = yes
	country_allow_conversion_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
	country_allow_conversion_open_prejudice_bool = yes
	country_allow_conversion_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
	country_allow_conversion_full_acceptance_bool = yes
	country_cultural_hegemony_art_mult = -0.03
	country_bureaucracy_investment_cost_factor_mult = -0.05
	country_family_limitation_literacy_mult = -0.5
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_church_and_state_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
exists = ruler
		ruler = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0

		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_state_religion
				power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_religious }
				religion = scope:target_country.religion
			}

			add = base_impose_law_weight

			# Very important for religious blocs
			if = {
				limit = { scope:target_country = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_freedom_of_conscience } }
				multiply = 2
			}
			else = {
				multiply = 5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target_country = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_military
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_tenant_farmers = {
	group = lawgroup_land_reform
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/tenant_farmers.dds"
	progressiveness = 0
	is_visible = {
NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_latifundias
			has_law = law_type:law_expanded_latifundias
		}
	}
	modifier = {
interest_group_ig_landowners_pol_str_mult = 0.00
	state_peasants_internal_migration_disallowed_bool = yes
	state_minimum_incorporated_subsistence_arable_land_add = 0.25
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = -1
	state_wealth_concentration_land_add = 5
	country_aristocrats_pol_str_mult = 0.25
	country_rigidity_baseline_add = 10
	}
	on_enact = {
if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = farmers_pb_ig_shift_effect_negative_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = rural_laborers_tu_ig_shift_effect_negative_tt
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0

		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}

		# Once the AI gets to a certain society tech level they should try to ditch Serfdom for Tenant Farmers
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_technology_researched = civilizing_mission
					has_technology_researched = human_rights
					has_technology_researched = pan-nationalism
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
			}

			add = 1000
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_journal_entry = je_meiji_main
					has_journal_entry = je_great_reforms_serfdom
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
			}
			add = 10000 # Top priority for Meiji AI is to get out of Serfdom, likewise for Great Reforms
		}

		# AI should really try to get out of Serfdom under the right circumstances
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_conservative_agenda }
					any_political_movement = {
						law_enactment_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
							value > neutral
						}
						political_movement_support >= 0.10
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_theocracy = {
	group = lawgroup_governance_principles
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/theocracy.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	disallowing_laws = {
law_total_separation
	}
	can_impose = {
OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_governance_principles_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_party_anti_reactionary
			}
			deactivate_law = law_type:law_party_anti_reactionary
		}
		bpm_deactivate_syndicalism = yes
	}
	on_deactivate = {
if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					has_law = law_type:law_subjecthood
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = because_subjecthood_is_active_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						save_temporary_scope_as = ig_to_check
						owner = {
							any_law = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number > 0
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ordered_interest_group = {
					limit = {
						is_in_government = yes
						save_temporary_scope_as = ig_to_check
						owner = {
							any_law = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number > 0
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
						}
					}
					order_by = ig_clout
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = ig_to_check
					owner = {
						ordered_law = {
							limit = {
								type = { save_temporary_scope_as = lawtype }
								scope:lawtype = { is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_subjecthood }
								law_is_available = yes
								NOT = {
									type ?= law_type:law_subjecthood
								}
							}
							position = 0
							order_by = bpm_interest_group_law_enactment_stance_as_number
							check_range_bounds = no
							prev.owner = {
								activate_law = prev.type
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				activate_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
			}
		}
	}
	modifier = {
country_clergymen_pol_str_mult = 0.5
	country_authority_add = 200
	country_legitimacy_ideological_incoherence_mult = 0.25
	country_cultural_pull_mult = -0.02
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = 1
	}
	ai_will_do = {
always = no
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda
				power_bloc ?= { has_identity = identity:identity_religious }
				religion = scope:target_country.religion
				scope:target_country = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?					
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}				
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
			if = {
				limit = { 
					scope:target_country = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic } 
					NOT = { has_strategy = ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda }
				}
				multiply = 5
			}		
			else = {
				multiply = 0.5 # AI is less likely to mess with governance principles unless dealing with council republics
			}
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:law_universal_suffrage = {
	group = lawgroup_distribution_of_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/universal_suffrage.dds"
	progressiveness = 100
	unlocking_technologies = {
egalitarianism
	}
	disallowing_laws = {
law_chiefdom
	}
	modifier = {
country_voting_power_base_add = 30
	country_authority_add = 100
	country_populist_movement_support_add = 0.05
	country_legitimacy_govt_total_votes_add = 150
	country_legitimacy_govt_total_clout_add = 30
	state_radicals_from_political_movements_mult = -0.05
	country_rigidity_baseline_add = -20
	country_colonial_stability_drift_add = -0.2
	country_colonial_invest_effectiveness_add = 0.3
	country_cultural_pull_mult = 0.03
	country_legislative_override_capacity_add = -3
	country_sol_expectations_lower_offset_add = 1
	}
	on_enact = {

			limit = {has_law = law_type:law_bakufu}
			custom_tooltip = bpm_voting_end_bakufu
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
scripted_effect_parties_emergence = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size }
			remove_modifier = bpm_republic_gov_size
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_date > 1836.1.1
			}
			initialize_electoral_confidence = yes
		}
		random_law = {
			limit = {
				type = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
			}
			save_scope_as = relevant_voting_law
		}
		handle_possible_absent_caciquismo_variables = yes
		inherit_caciquismo_effect = yes
		inherit_free_elections_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				has_variable = king_in_parliament_possible
				NOT = {
					has_journal_entry = je_king_in_parliament
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = king_in_parliament_tt
				add_journal_entry = { type = je_king_in_parliament }
			}
		}
	}
	can_impose = {
country_has_voting_franchise = yes # modification of the standard trigger, only countries with a voting franchise can impose democracy on others
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_distribution_of_power_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
#Petitions
		value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda	
				scope:target_country = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
					NOR = { 
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting				 
						has_law = law_type:law_anarchy
					}
				}
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
		}
	}

}

		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
value = 0
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
				has_strategy = ai_strategy_progressive_agenda	
				scope:target_country = { # Is their law different enough from what we want to impose?
					NOR = { 
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting 
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting 
					}
				}
			}
			
			add = base_impose_law_weight
		}
	}

}
